item0.title: Convex Safe Corridor & LO-MPC Multi-Robot Motion Planning
item0.desc: Targeting multi-robot coordination and obstacle avoidance in dense environments, designed a full-stack motion planning pipeline from 2D safe inflation, modified A* topological pruning, convex safe corridor polygon construction, minimum snap continuous trajectory optimization, to CasADi lexicographic MPC. Formation tracking error < 0.05m with a 50ms control loop.

item1.title: SO-ARM & LeRobot Teleoperation & Embodied Imitation Learning
item1.desc: Built an open-source 6-DOF SO-ARM physical robot and master-slave teleoperation platform using STS3215 serial bus servos; formulated high-fidelity URDF dynamic simulation in MuJoCo, validating rigid body kinematics and grasp collisions; established real-time teleoperation data collection pipeline at 50Hz via Hugging Face LeRobot; trained ACT and Diffusion Policy models for tabletop manipulation, closing the loop from simulation to physical serial bus servo execution.

item2.title: 2025 RoboCup Rescue Robot Control & Multi-DOF Arm Manipulation
item2.desc: Engineered the embedded control and manipulation stack for an urban search & rescue robot. Built bi-directional CAN communication linking upper Linux/ROS and lower STM32 MCU; solved multi-DOF arm analytical forward/inverse kinematics with joint constraints; designed 5th-order quintic polynomial smooth trajectories; tuned DJI M2006 BLDC cascade PID loops. Awarded 3rd Prize Nationally in RoboCup China Open 2025.

item3.title: LiDAR-IMU SLAM & MPPI Autonomous Navigation Stack in ROS 2
item3.desc: Engineered a modular ROS 2 (Humble) & Gazebo autonomy stack inspired by Nav2 and TrailBlazer. Leveraged Server-Plugin-Lifecycle architecture with Pluginlib dynamic plugin loading; integrated FAST-LIO2 tightly-coupled LiDAR-IMU 6-DOF odometry; deployed pointcloud PCA ground filter and incremental 3D ESDF cost field; planned B-spline global paths and executed high-dynamic local collision avoidance via MPPI controller.
